BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to craft wine and wineries; and adding a newchapter to Title 66 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions ofthis chapter apply only to craft wineries, as defined in section 2 ofthis act, that are currently registered as such with the board, whichmust register applicants that elect in writing to be so classified.

(1) The following definitionsapply throughout this chapter unless the context clearly requiresotherwise. (a) "Craft wine" means the product fermented at a craft winery andregulated as wine by the federal tax and trade bureau under Title 27C.F.R. (b) "Craft winery" means the holder of a domestic winery license orcertificate of approval and of a federal basic permit as a bondedwinery or bonded wine cellar that did not produce more than twentyfivethousand gallons of wine in the most recent year for which it reportedproduction under Title 27 C.F.R. p. 1 SB 5257 (2) Notwithstanding any other provision of this title, winefermented at a craft winery, except as otherwise expressly provided inthis chapter, is not "wine" or "liquor" for the purposes of any otherchapter of this title.

(1) There shall be a license to be issued to anycraft winery; the fee for such license may not be greater than theexisting fee provided in RCW 66.24.170(1) for domestic wineries. (2) A craft winery licensed under this section may do all thingsnecessary or convenient for the manufacture, distribution, and sale ofcraft wine that are not expressly forbidden to craft wineries underthis chapter or contrary to law other than the provisions of thistitle, including without limitation sale of craft wine at wholesale andretail to any purchaser entitled to purchase craft wine or wine. (3) Craft wine is deemed wine for the purposes of RCW 66.12.020,66.12.180, 66.20.300, 66.20.310, 66.20.320, 66.20.330, 66.20.340,66.20.350, 66.24.185, 66.24.210, 66.24.215, and 66.28.110 and chapters66.16, 66.32, 66.36, and 66.44 RCW. (4) Holders of licenses or permits to deal in wine pursuant toother chapters of this title may deal in craft wine in the same manneras wine, including without limitation exercise of retail licenseprivileges, importer license privileges, wine distributor licenseprivileges, and conduct of retail and wholesale licensed businesses.
Craft wineries may not extendcredit on the purchase of craft wine by Washington retail licensees.
A registered craft winery mustmake reports to the board at intervals provided by the board pursuantto the regulations.
Sections 1 through 5 of this act constitutea new chapter in Title 66 RCW.
